_meta.purpose: The compass on the Me tab: what a student is good at and what matters to them, as lists to tap. What a student enjoys reads the six interests in goals.json, so there is one list of those.
_meta.source: Authored for this app. The three parts follow the self awareness strand of MOE's Education and Career Guidance (interests, abilities and values); the wording is this app's.
_meta.notes: Nothing here scores or types a student. The lists only offer words; the student picks, and can add one line of proof for each strength. No list is ranked and none maps to a place after secondary school.

parts.head: What you are good at
parts.ask: Pick up to three. Add what shows it.

parts.head: Where you are aiming
parts.ask: Set a goal when you are ready.

strengths.label: Making or fixing things by hand
Staying with a task until it is done
Getting on with all kinds of people
Staying calm when things go wrong

values.label: Learning new things all the time
Being part of a close team

student: Which of these would a friend say about you?
What did you do this term that shows one of them?
parent: Ask: which of these feels most like you, and why?
Ask: when did you last feel proud of your work?
teacher: Ask: what shows this strength in class or CCA?
Ask: which of these do you want to grow this year?
